name: Our Demise
source:
Zero, the leader of a team helping as many civilians as they can survive the aftermath of the apocalypse known as The Panic, has dealt with his issues of low self-esteem, a savior complex, and guilt about his true role in all of this by overworking himself. His second in command and close friend Leon has a plan to get him to unwind (well, hopefully, at least a little). 

[From [url=https://kyokurangi.itch.io/our-demise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
零是一个团队的领导者，他帮助尽可能多的平民在被称为“恐慌”的世界末日中幸存下来，他通过过度劳累来解决自己的低自尊、救世主情结以及对自己在这一切中的真正角色的愧疚等问题。他的副手兼亲密朋友莱昂有一个让他放松的计划（好吧，希望至少是一点点）。

[来自[url=https://kyokurangi.itch.io/our-demise]itch.io[/url]]
